guardrails.description: Back extensor endurance holds while the main lifts get heavier (Sorensen hold no lower than baseline)
Engine holds while strength and skills are the focus (10-min Echo bike no lower than baseline)

rationale: Block 1 builds strength, then peaks for the CrossFit Open. For the Open the limiter is movement access, not strength: kipping, chest-to-bar, toes-to-bar and muscle-ups all sit on strict pulling, and strict pull-ups (10, 83% of the 12-15 benchmark) are both a real gap and Open-specific. Goal: strict pull-ups 10 -> 12.5 (+25%), alongside the kipping ladder 2x/week. The hinge (69%, the biggest strength gap) keeps progressing as a main lift every week and is a Block 2 focus test. Guardrails: the Sorensen hold must not drop (back history) and the 10-min Echo bike must not drop (the engine the Open needs). Calorie phase stays recomp.
calorie_phase_reason: Body fat ~14% against a 10-12% goal with weight near the 200 lb target: recomp (maintenance to a slight deficit, high protein) keeps strength and skill progressing.
